chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Qasim ibn Yahya from his grandfather al-Hasan ibn Rashid from Muhammad ibn Muslim from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: 'Licking honey is a cure for every illness.'
There comes forth from their bellies a drink of varying colors, in which is healing for the people.
And it, along with the recitation of the Quran and chewing frankincense, melts the phlegm.
ai.seo_question: What are the spiritual and physical benefits of honey according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this narration from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) attributes the healing power of honey to Imam Ali (AS), linking it to the Quranic verse in Surah An-Nahl (16:69) which describes honey as a 'healing for people.' The hadith further elaborates on practical therapeutic applications, noting that combining honey with Quranic recitation and chewing frankincense effectively dissolves phlegm, reflecting the Shia tradition of integrating spiritual and physical remedies.
